title: Karan Johar Defends Alia Bhatt Amid Criticism
excerpt: Karan Johar has responded to critics of Alia Bhatt, asserting her stardom as 'undebatable'. He emphasized her significant impact in the entertainment industry.
body: In a robust defense of Alia Bhatt's career, Karan Johar has countered the recent criticisms directed at her stardom. He labeled her position in the entertainment sphere as 'undebatable,' highlighting her influence and success. Johar's comments come amidst a backdrop of ongoing discussions around the roles of prominent figures in the film industry, reaffirming Bhatt's significant contributions to Indian cinema over the past decade.

title: Tokyo Tops List of Most Liveable Cities Worldwide
excerpt: Tokyo has been ranked as the most liveable city in the world, with Madrid and Paris also making the top 10. Factors influencing these rankings include quality of life.
body: Tokyo has been ranked as the most liveable city in the world, with Madrid and Paris also making the top 10. Factors influencing these rankings include quality of life, infrastructure, safety, healthcare access, and cost of living. Urban planners point to Tokyo's efficient public transit and low crime rate as key differentiators compared to other major global cities.

title: Supriya Pathak Shah's Besan and Malai Ubtan Benefits

body: Supriya Pathak Shah endorses a traditional besan and malai ubtan, claiming it effectively slows down unwanted hair growth while enhancing skin texture. The actress shared the home remedy passed down in her family, combining gram flour and fresh malai for a natural glow.

title: Salman Khan's Maatrubhumi Yet to Submit for Censor Approval
excerpt: Salman Khan confirms that his film Maatrubhumi has not been submitted to the censor board for approval, dispelling rumors of it being stuck.
body: Salman Khan confirms that his film Maatrubhumi has not been submitted to the censor board for approval, dispelling rumors of it being stuck in the certification process.
